Where training can enter next

Genetic search can propose path words, observation routes and finite policy rows. A transformer can propose the same structural edits from a question and the native failure witnesses. A market can allocate scarce query or revision capacity through explicit bids, accepted transfers and costs. Each proposal would pass through these existing publication, drawing, seam and ownership checks. None of those learning systems is running in this gallery.

Keep closure, valid current-head receipts, single ownership and visible blocked participation as hard constraints. Useful objectives include broader seam agreement, symmetry with an actual correspondence proof, limited revision work and interesting motif/field balance. These are separate objectives: four stubborn seams here preserve a symmetric conflict, and visual regularity alone does not settle that conflict.
